title: CFTC gets into legal clash over stock perps after having cleared path for crypto version
summary: A group backed by Citadel Securities and other firms sued the U.S. derivatives regulator for opening a path for perps that it argued belong in the SEC's hands.

title: Justin Sun seeks sanctions against Trump-linked World Liberty Financial over UAE ties
summary: The Tron founder says World Liberty failed to disclose its UAE ties until months into his lawsuit over $45 million in WLFI tokens.

title: South Korea's president says country needs a ‘cybersecurity czar’ following $6.3 billion Binance hack
summary: Lee Jae Myung said he wants a government-wide agency to tackle cyberattacks as AI raises security concerns across financial institutions and critical infrastructure.

title: Amazon, Tesla and SpaceX join OKX–ICE tokenized stock objections as deadline looms
summary: Objections have reached 56 companies, with nearly 80% of the venture’s initial stock selection opting out.

title: Stablecoin governance group behind OUSD sets out management fee, offers equity earning pool
summary: Governance group Open Standard will charge a 0.1 basis point management fee on payment volume, capped at at $0.01 per payment.
